# A web page's dialogs: confirm(), prompt() and alert() are sheets on the
# window naming the page's host, and the page gets the answer; its
# <input type=file> gets the files picked (a probe's pick, the open panel
# apart). A block's page gets no sheet. tests/run.sh serves @SITE@ (as
# @HOST@); @ROOT@ is the repository.
browser:open @SITE@/dialogs.html ==> b1
page-wait:go
expect-tab:Probe Dialogs
# (Clicked a moment after page-js has its answer: the page waits for the
# sheet's, and page-js would wait with it.)
page-js:(() => { setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('delete').click(), 300); return "asked"; })() ==> asked
wait:0.8
expect-sheet:yes
expect-sheet-text:@HOST@ says
expect-sheet-text:Delete the draft?
sheet:Cancel
expect-page:kept
page-js:(() => { setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('delete').click(), 300); return "asked"; })() ==> asked
wait:0.8
sheet:OK
expect-page:deleted
# prompt(): its field starts with the page's text; what's typed goes back.
page-js:(() => { setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('rename').click(), 300); return "asked"; })() ==> asked
wait:0.8
expect-sheet-text:A new name?
expect-sheet-text:draft
sheet-type:final plan
sheet:OK
expect-page:named final plan
page-js:(() => { setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('rename').click(), 300); return "asked"; })() ==> asked
wait:0.8
sheet:Cancel
expect-page:no name
page-js:(() => { setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('hello').click(), 300); return "asked"; })() ==> asked
wait:0.8
expect-sheet-text:Hello there
sheet:OK
expect-page:greeted
expect-sheet:no
# A file input: what's picked goes to the page.
pick-files:@ROOT@/tests/fixtures/site/index.html|@ROOT@/tests/fixtures/site/second.html
page-js:(() => { document.getElementById('file').click(); return "clicked"; })() ==> clicked
wait:0.8
expect-page:picked index.html 383, second.html 100
# A block's page asks nothing of the window: confirm() is answered no at once.
action:open_tasks
wait:1.0
page-wait:go
page-js:String(confirm('Anything?')) ==> false
expect-sheet:no
